newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shares close lower after half-day trading.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shares close lower after half-day trading.

text.p: Dutch shares lingered in negative territory all day on Tuesday, but the losses were marginal and volumes low, dealers said.
The market closed at 1230 GMT ahead of the Christmas holidays.
The AEX share index was down 1.08 points at 633.95. Shipbuilder IHC Caland was one of the few strong performers after the firm said it had won new orders worth $125 million.

"The rise would have been greater if more investors had been about, but volumes were meagre ahead of Christmas," said one dealer. IHC Caland rose 3.90 guilders to 97.20. Unilever sprinted ahead at the open and hit 303.50 guilders.
Unilever's gains eroded somewhat during the session and the stock closed two guilders higher at 302.50.
Royal Dutch made a strong start, but closed 0.50 guilders lower at 296.50.
